veranderings.rede: 'Word welkom' (become welcome) is unidiomatic; 'word verwelkom' is the natural passive for being welcomed.

veranderings.voor: Ons noem die gewoonte om nuwelinge ten volle op te neem heelhartige aanvaarding.
veranderings.na: Die gewoonte om nuwelinge ten volle op te neem, noem ons heelhartige aanvaarding.
veranderings.rede: The long om-te clause runs straight into the term, so a learner struggles to see where the name begins; fronting the clause with a comma makes the term stand clearly at the end.

veranderings.blok: Grond vir die gesin en die vee
veranderings.rede: 'Van ... weet ons' is the natural way to say what is known about a group; 'uit' reads as coming out of the communities. The protected phrase stays intact.

veranderings.voor: Taal is self 'n bron wat kontak wys.
veranderings.na: Taal self is 'n bron wat kontak wys.
veranderings.rede: Placing 'self' directly after 'Taal' gives the intended emphasis (language itself) more clearly than after the verb.
